name: Toki Watari no Serenade
source:
You were always working hard wishing to become a professional pianist.
One day, you were feeling blue from your practice not going well. That is when a truck hits you.
When you woke up, you were in the 1700s.
And then appeared the legendary composers: Beethoven, Schumann, Liszt and Chopin.
When you were confused and startled, you hear about the assassination of Mozart.
Can the protagonist and the 5 composers solve the assassination of Mozart?
And can she go back to her era?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.seiyoukaigai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你一直努力練習，希望成為職業鋼琴家。

某天，練習不順讓你情緒低落，就在這時，一輛卡車撞上了你。

醒來後，你發現自己身處18世紀。

接著，傳奇作曲家們出現在你面前：貝多芬、舒曼、李斯特和蕭邦。

你困惑又驚訝之際，聽說莫札特遭到暗殺。

主角和五位作曲家能解開莫札特遇刺之謎嗎？
她能回到自己的時代嗎？

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.seiyoukaigai]Google Play[/url]]
